integrity: The algebraic proof applies to every projective plane; numerical checks cover only PG(2,p) for p=2,3,5,7 and are not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes an existing finite projective plane, its ordinary shortest-path metric, and real positive exponents. Classical incidence and Schoenberg theory are used; priority beyond bounded primary-literature comparison is not established.
title: Sharp Fourier-positivity thresholds for projective-plane distance hypergroups
